Economy · India

Indian Auto Sales Rise Amid Mixed Economic Signals

India's automotive sector saw robust wholesale sales in June, with major manufacturers reporting significant growth driven by sustained consumer demand, including for electric vehicles. This surge occurred despite reported price hikes for petrol and diesel. Concurrently, India's manufacturing sector experienced a slowdown, with growth moderating to a three-month low due to weaker demand, according to PMI data.
